documentTitle: EGAST GA9 — VFR Phraseology Pocket Guide
closureReason: manifested windows landed, no pending records, no source-window hardening backlog

sections.notes: Readback advisory family. Mixed best-practice prose, bullet list of items requiring readback, acknowledgement-by-callsign rule, Wilco usage, and read-back-when-required guidance, with inline page-layout noise. No clause numbering.

sourceUnits.claimText: ‘Wilco’ may be used for brevity, or where readback of an instruction or part of an instruction might be confused with a transmission advising completion of the action instructed.
sourceUnits.rationale: Consistent advisory requirement for acknowledging non-readback transmissions.

sourceUnits.claimText: ‘Wilco’ means ‘I understand your message and will comply’. It should not be used in place of a full read back of the items on page 10.
sourceUnits.rationale: Consistent definition and prohibition against using Wilco as a substitute for full readback.
exactSourceQuotes: ‘Wilco’ means ‘I understand your message and will comply’.
It should not be used in place of a full read back of the items on page 10.

sourceUnits.claimText: When a read back is required you must ensure it is complete and follow it with your callsign.
sourceUnits.rationale: Consistent mandatory requirement for completeness and callsign inclusion.
exactSourceQuotes: When a read back is required you must ensure it is complete and follow it with your callsign.

sourceUnits.claimText: If departure instructions are transmitted together with a take-off clearance, it may be more logical to read back the take-off clearance first, followed by the departure instructions.
sourceUnits.rationale: Consistent advisory requirement for acknowledging non-readback transmissions.
exactSourceQuotes: if departure instructions are transmitted together with a take-off clearance, it may be more logical to read back the take-off clearance first, followed by the departure instructions.

sourceUnits.claimText: If in any doubt you must request clarification.
sourceUnits.rationale: Consistent mandatory requirement to request clarification when in doubt.
exactSourceQuotes: If in any doubt you must request clarification.

curationApplied.reasoning: The claim text is verbatim supported by the source, and the source uses the word “must” for this specific instruction. Because the authority class is already best_practice, this does not improperly elevate the advisory document to an authoritative requirement, but the modality should match the source wording.

sourceUnits.claimText: Reading back a clearance and any safety critical information helps both the pilot and the controller understand what the aircraft has been instructed to do.
sourceUnits.rationale: Background support explaining the rationale for readbacks, not a direct operational obligation.
exactSourceQuotes: Reading back a clearance and any safety critical information helps both the pilot and the controller understand what the aircraft has been instructed to do.

curationApplied.reasoning: The quote is verbatim and the claim accurately captures explanatory background rather than an operative readback obligation. Because the source wording is non-normative rationale, it should remain a note but be classified as background support rather than best practice.

sourceUnits.claimText: Messages containing clearances/instructions to enter, land on, take-off from, hold short of, cross or backtrack any runway must be read back.
sourceUnits.rationale: Consistent mandatory readback requirement for runway operations across all attempts.
exactSourceQuotes: Messages containing the following must be read back:
Clearances/instructions to enter, land on, take-off from, hold short of, cross or backtrack any runway
